# sql

Types from the Go package `sql` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## sql.IsolationLevel

IsolationLevel is the transaction isolation level used in [`TxOptions`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltxoptions).

Has everything <code>Number</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns the name of the transaction isolation level. |

## sql.Conn

Conn represents a single database connection rather than a pool of database
connections. Prefer running queries from [`DB`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb) unless there is a specific
need for a continuous single database connection.

A Conn must call [`Conn.close`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlconn) to return the connection to the database pool
and may do so concurrently with a running query.

After a call to [`Conn.close`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlconn), all operations on the
connection fail with `ErrConnDone`.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `pingContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): void</code> | PingContext verifies the connection to the database is still alive. |
| `execContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">Result</a></code> | ExecContext executes a query without returning any rows. The args are for any placeholder parameters in the query. |
| `queryContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">Rows</a>)</code> | QueryContext executes a query that returns rows, typically a SELECT. The args are for any placeholder parameters in the query. |
| `queryRowContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow">Row</a>)</code> | QueryRowContext executes a query that is expected to return at most one row. QueryRowContext always returns a non-nil value. Errors are deferred until the [*Row.Scan] method is called. If the query selects no rows, the [*Row.Scan] will return `ErrNoRows`. Otherwise, the [*Row.Scan] scans the first selected row and discards the rest. |
| `prepareContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | PrepareContext creates a prepared statement for later queries or executions. Multiple queries or executions may be run concurrently from the returned statement. The caller must call the statement's [*Stmt.Close] method when the statement is no longer needed. |
| `raw()` | <code>(f: (driverConn: any) =&gt; void): void</code> | Raw executes f exposing the underlying driver connection for the duration of f. The driverConn must not be used outside of f. |
| `beginTx()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, opts: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltxoptions">TxOptions</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx">Tx</a>)</code> | BeginTx starts a transaction. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close returns the connection to the connection pool. All operations after a Close will return with `ErrConnDone`. Close is safe to call concurrently with other operations and will block until all other operations finish. It may be useful to first cancel any used context and then call close directly after. |

## sql.ColumnType

ColumnType contains the name and type of a column.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name()` | <code>(): string</code> | Name returns the name or alias of the column. |
| `length()` | <code>(): [number, boolean]</code> | Length returns the column type length for variable length column types such as text and binary field types. If the type length is unbounded the value will be `math.maxInt64` (any database limits will still apply). If the column type is not variable length, such as an int, or if not supported by the driver ok is false. |
| `decimalSize()` | <code>(): [number, number, boolean]</code> | DecimalSize returns the scale and precision of a decimal type. If not applicable or if not supported ok is false. |
| `scanType()` | <code>(): any</code> | ScanType returns a Go type suitable for scanning into using [`Rows.scan`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows). If a driver does not support this property ScanType will return the type of an empty interface. |
| `nullable()` | <code>(): [boolean, boolean]</code> | Nullable reports whether the column may be null. If a driver does not support this property ok will be false. |
| `databaseTypeName()` | <code>(): string</code> | DatabaseTypeName returns the database system name of the column type. If an empty string is returned, then the driver type name is not supported. Consult your driver documentation for a list of driver data types. [`ColumnType.length`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlcolumntype) specifiers are not included. Common type names include "VARCHAR", "TEXT", "NVARCHAR", "DECIMAL", "BOOL", "INT", and "BIGINT". |

## sql.Row

Row is the result of calling [`DB.queryRow`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb) to select a single row.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `scan()` | <code>(...dest: any[]): void</code> | Scan copies the columns from the matched row into the values pointed at by dest. See the documentation on [`Rows.scan`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) for details. If more than one row matches the query, Scan uses the first row and discards the rest. If no row matches the query, Scan returns `ErrNoRows`. |
| `err()` | <code>(): void</code> | Err provides a way for wrapping packages to check for query errors without calling [`Row.scan`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow). Err returns the error, if any, that was encountered while running the query. If this error is not nil, this error will also be returned from [`Row.scan`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow). |

| `readOnly` | <code>boolean</code> |  |

## sql.NullString

NullString represents a string that may be null.
NullString implements the `Scanner` interface so
it can be used as a scan destination:

```
	var s NullString
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT name FROM foo WHERE id=?", id).Scan(&s)
	...
	if s.Valid {
	   // use s.String
	} else {
	   // NULL value
	}
```

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `string` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `valid` | <code>boolean // Valid is true if String is not NULL</code> |  |
| `scan()` | <code>(value: any): void</code> | Scan implements the `Scanner` interface. |
| `value()` | <code>(): any</code> | Value implements the `driver.valuer` interface. |

## sql.DB

DB is a database handle representing a pool of zero or more
underlying connections. It's safe for concurrent use by multiple
goroutines.

The sql package creates and frees connections automatically; it
also maintains a free pool of idle connections. If the database has
a concept of per-connection state, such state can be reliably observed
within a transaction ([`Tx`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx)) or connection ([`Conn`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlconn)). Once [`DB.begin`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb) is called, the
returned [`Tx`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) is bound to a single connection. Once [`Tx.commit`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or
[`Tx.rollback`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) is called on the transaction, that transaction's
connection is returned to [`DB`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb)'s idle connection pool. The pool size
can be controlled with [`DB.setMaxIdleConns`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `pingContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): void</code> | PingContext verifies a connection to the database is still alive, establishing a connection if necessary. |
| `ping()` | <code>(): void</code> | Ping verifies a connection to the database is still alive, establishing a connection if necessary. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the database and prevents new queries from starting. Close then waits for all queries that have started processing on the server to finish. |
| `setMaxIdleConns()` | <code>(n: number): void</code> | SetMaxIdleConns sets the maximum number of connections in the idle connection pool. |
| `setMaxOpenConns()` | <code>(n: number): void</code> | SetMaxOpenConns sets the maximum number of open connections to the database. |
| `setConnMaxLifetime()` | <code>(d: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a>): void</code> | SetConnMaxLifetime sets the maximum amount of time a connection may be reused. |
| `setConnMaxIdleTime()` | <code>(d: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a>): void</code> | SetConnMaxIdleTime sets the maximum amount of time a connection may be idle. |
| `stats()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldbstats">DBStats</a></code> | Stats returns database statistics. |
| `prepareContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | PrepareContext creates a prepared statement for later queries or executions. Multiple queries or executions may be run concurrently from the returned statement. The caller must call the statement's [*Stmt.Close] method when the statement is no longer needed. |

## sql.Tx

Tx is an in-progress database transaction.

A transaction must end with a call to [`Tx.commit`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Tx.rollback`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx).

After a call to [`Tx.commit`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Tx.rollback`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx), all operations on the
transaction fail with `ErrTxDone`.

The statements prepared for a transaction by calling
the transaction's [`Tx.prepare`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Tx.stmt`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) methods are closed
by the call to [`Tx.commit`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Tx.rollback`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `commit()` | <code>(): void</code> | Commit commits the transaction. |
| `rollback()` | <code>(): void</code> | Rollback aborts the transaction. |
| `prepareContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | PrepareContext creates a prepared statement for use within a transaction. |
| `prepare()` | <code>(query: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | Prepare creates a prepared statement for use within a transaction. |
| `stmtContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, stmt: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | StmtContext returns a transaction-specific prepared statement from an existing statement. |
| `stmt()` | <code>(stmt: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlstmt">Stmt</a>)</code> | Stmt returns a transaction-specific prepared statement from an existing statement. |
| `execContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">Result</a></code> | ExecContext executes a query that doesn't return rows. For example: an INSERT and UPDATE. |
| `exec()` | <code>(query: string, ...args: any[]): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">Result</a></code> | Exec executes a query that doesn't return rows. For example: an INSERT and UPDATE. |
| `queryContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">Rows</a>)</code> | QueryContext executes a query that returns rows, typically a SELECT. |
| `query()` | <code>(query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">Rows</a>)</code> | Query executes a query that returns rows, typically a SELECT. |
| `queryRowContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow">Row</a>)</code> | QueryRowContext executes a query that is expected to return at most one row. QueryRowContext always returns a non-nil value. Errors are deferred until [`Row`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow)'s Scan method is called. If the query selects no rows, the [*Row.Scan] will return `ErrNoRows`. Otherwise, the [*Row.Scan] scans the first selected row and discards the rest. |
| `queryRow()` | <code>(query: string, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow">Row</a>)</code> | QueryRow executes a query that is expected to return at most one row. QueryRow always returns a non-nil value. Errors are deferred until [`Row`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow)'s Scan method is called. If the query selects no rows, the [*Row.Scan] will return `ErrNoRows`. Otherwise, the [*Row.Scan] scans the first selected row and discards the rest. |

## sql.Stmt

Stmt is a prepared statement.
A Stmt is safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines.

If a Stmt is prepared on a [`Tx`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Conn`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlconn), it will be bound to a single
underlying connection forever. If the [`Tx`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx) or [`Conn`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlconn) closes, the Stmt will
become unusable and all operations will return an error.
If a Stmt is prepared on a [`DB`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb), it will remain usable for the lifetime of the
[`DB`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb). When the Stmt needs to execute on a new underlying connection, it will
prepare itself on the new connection automatically.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `execContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, ...args: any[]): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">Result</a></code> | ExecContext executes a prepared statement with the given arguments and returns a [`Result`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult) summarizing the effect of the statement. |
| `exec()` | <code>(...args: any[]): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">Result</a></code> | Exec executes a prepared statement with the given arguments and returns a [`Result`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult) summarizing the effect of the statement. |
| `queryContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">Rows</a>)</code> | QueryContext executes a prepared query statement with the given arguments and returns the query results as a [*Rows]. |
| `query()` | <code>(...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">Rows</a>)</code> | Query executes a prepared query statement with the given arguments and returns the query results as a *Rows. |
| `queryRowContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, ...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow">Row</a>)</code> | QueryRowContext executes a prepared query statement with the given arguments. If an error occurs during the execution of the statement, that error will be returned by a call to Scan on the returned [*Row], which is always non-nil. If the query selects no rows, the [*Row.Scan] will return `ErrNoRows`. Otherwise, the [*Row.Scan] scans the first selected row and discards the rest. |
| `queryRow()` | <code>(...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrow">Row</a>)</code> | QueryRow executes a prepared query statement with the given arguments. If an error occurs during the execution of the statement, that error will be returned by a call to Scan on the returned [*Row], which is always non-nil. If the query selects no rows, the [*Row.Scan] will return `ErrNoRows`. Otherwise, the [*Row.Scan] scans the first selected row and discards the rest. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the statement. |

## sql.Rows

Rows is the result of a query. Its cursor starts before the first row
of the result set. Use [`Rows.next`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) to advance from row to row.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `next()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | Next prepares the next result row for reading with the [`Rows.scan`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) method. It returns true on success, or false if there is no next result row or an error happened while preparing it. [`Rows.err`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) should be consulted to distinguish between the two cases. |
| `nextResultSet()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | NextResultSet prepares the next result set for reading. It reports whether there is further result sets, or false if there is no further result set or if there is an error advancing to it. The [`Rows.err`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) method should be consulted to distinguish between the two cases. |
| `err()` | <code>(): void</code> | Err returns the error, if any, that was encountered during iteration. Err may be called after an explicit or implicit [`Rows.close`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows). |
| `columns()` | <code>(): Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | Columns returns the column names. Columns returns an error if the rows are closed. |
| `columnTypes()` | <code>(): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlcolumntype">ColumnType</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | ColumnTypes returns column information such as column type, length, and nullable. Some information may not be available from some drivers. |
| `scan()` | <code>(...dest: any[]): void</code> | Scan copies the columns in the current row into the values pointed at by dest. The number of values in dest must be the same as the number of columns in [`Rows`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows). |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the [`Rows`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows), preventing further enumeration. If [`Rows.next`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) is called and returns false and there are no further result sets, the [`Rows`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows) are closed automatically and it will suffice to check the result of [`Rows.err`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows). Close is idempotent and does not affect the result of [`Rows.err`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows). |

## sql.Result

A Result summarizes an executed SQL command.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lastInsertId()` | <code>(): number</code> | LastInsertId returns the integer generated by the database in response to a command. Typically this will be from an "auto increment" column when inserting a new row. Not all databases support this feature, and the syntax of such statements varies. |
| `rowsAffected()` | <code>(): number</code> | RowsAffected returns the number of rows affected by an update, insert, or delete. Not every database or database driver may support this. |
